record_title: Normalizer rigidity for the Kummer deck group of the even Ma-Wang maximal curves
provenance: Scientific derivation from the Ma-Wang Kummer model and ramification data, with the proof and literature review documented in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The motivating preprint arXiv:2609.19546v1 was submitted on 17 September 2026, so unindexed contemporaneous work remains a residual risk. The result determines the normalizer and centralizer of the distinguished Kummer deck group, not the full automorphism group of the even-n curve. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
